document.about: Reproductive Health 2015, 12:13, 'Adolescent first births in East Africa: disaggregating characteristics, trends and determinants', PMC4429933. Its Table 8 (p7) is set in three country blocks ruled under every cell: each block's title (`Uganda | 1995 | 2011 | Average annual % rate of change`, then Kenya, then Tanzania) over the same line of column names (`<16 | 16/17 | 18/19 | <20` three times) and six rows by wealth quintile. The PDF is linked from the PMC article page; PMC refuses scripted downloads.

notes: 2026-11-25 (restated blocks, from #351's audit): Uganda's and Kenya's blocks were one table, Kenya's title and column line read as rows of data, and Tanzania's block was a table of its own. All three are now one table: each title a section over its block's rows and each column line a restated header for them.
